largeheadline_copy.line1: Our proactive approach
largeheadline_copy.line2: With ProCare Service, we offer you operational and financial peace of mind through three comprehensive offerings: ProCare Preventive Maintenance, ProCare Protect and ProCare Prevent. Choose the medical equipment service package that best meets your needs.

text_1880669833.text:
Preventive Maintenance

With ProCare Preventive Maintenance, a dedicated, on-site Stryker ProCare medical device technician works with you to enable maximum performance and workflow management solutions related to equipment utilization and uptime, staff engagement and patient safety.

ProCare Protect

ProCare Protect is a maintenance and service solution that provides OEM support with unlimited service calls, enabling you to balance equipment uptime needs within your budget.

ProCare Prevent

The optimal program for customers who need a total solution, ProCare Prevent provides enhanced service solutions to get the most from your equipment. ProCare Prevent includes unlimited service calls, OEM parts and annual preventive maintenance inspections, all with proper documentation.

Optimize your investment

 

The reliability of our products is just the beginning of the Stryker commitment to customer satisfaction. While Stryker equipment is designed to perform over time, continue to invest in your capital equipment with a ProCare Service solution. Our service solutions aim to provide a high standard of service and support for your facility's needs and are customizable and scalable to any budget.

pageshortdescription.shortDescTop:
Every day, you count on your medical equipment to perform at its best. With ProCare Services, our people help to ensure your equipment is ready to perform when it's needed and help make it easier to get the most from your investment. When an issue arises, we promise to help solve it-making repairs quickly and correctly. 

 

Our team provides preventive maintenance and service support to help enhance the reliability and maximize the life of your equipment. ProCare isn't just a service program. It's a partnership you can count on to give you one less thing to worry about, and one more reason to feel confident you're doing all you can for your clinicians, staff, and patients.
